text:
The Earth is a planet that orbits the Sun once in approximately 365 days.
What does this enable us to explain?
A
the cycle of day and night
B
the cycle of phases of the moon
C
the periodic nature of the seasons
D
the apparent daily motion of the Sun

options.label: A
options.text: the cycle of day and night

options.label: B
options.text: the cycle of phases of the moon

options.label: C
options.text: the periodic nature of the seasons

options.label: D
options.text: the apparent daily motion of the Sun
